source: Mineral PDF vector paths and raster layout only; PDF /VP /Measure geographic transform and CRS declaration were not used.
method: Robust nearest-boundary registration of parsed International_Boundary vector paths in page coordinates to the fixed Nigeria Admin-0 polygon in a local metric projection. Printed graticule supplied only an initial guess.
model: lon = lon_center + lon_deg_per_1000_page_pt * (page_x - page_x_center) / 1000; lat = lat_center + lat_deg_per_1000_page_pt * (page_y - page_y_center) / 1000

independent_capital_check.use: QA only; many marker centers are obscured and the named city-center references are approximate, so they were not weighted against the stronger national-boundary fit.

limitations: Map-symbol raster resolution is approximately 0.68 km per pixel (75 dpi at roughly 1:2,000,000).
The Natural Earth reference polygon is generalized; boundary-fit residuals are not survey accuracy.
Capital-point check is less consistent than boundary alignment and is retained as a caution.
